w: The evening assembly was declared as 'Parent's Day'. After a drama presented by the kishores and yuvaks, Swamishri addressed the assembly in the same vein: "As parents, we should take extra care of our children because our world has become more materialistic. Consequently, our problems have multiplied. But if God or this holy sadhu becomes a priority in life then we can solve and find solutions to many of our problems. "Because we live a householder's life it doesn't mean we should not think of our worldly responsibilities - occupation, business, money. But along with this if Satsang (spirituality) and God are predominant in our lives, then there will be peace and happiness in our life as a householder. We will also be successful in life. If we perform arti and puja in the house, read Satsang books and have spiritual dialogues then our children will become exposed to and consolidated in Satsang matters. "One has to take great care in rearing children. Just as if one wants to grow a mango tree, one has to take great pains, but trees that flourish of their own accord are of no use! And since a mango tree is a fruit bearing tree one has to take special care"

The 3-day camp for youth volunteers (Yuva karyakar) commenced with Swamishri lighting the inaugural lamp and blessing the assembly. The three-day agenda comprised of speeches by senior sadhus, question answer sessions with Swamishri and reports on satsang activities by sadhus and karyakars. Over 400 karyakars had a special opportunity of Swamishri's darshan and samagam.

In the evening Bal-Kishore Day assembly Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami addressed parents to inspire values in children. Thereafter balaks and kishores performed a drama called 'Khoj' (Search). Finally Swamishri eloquently talked about the need for parents to inspire values and satsang in children.

Welcome assembly The evening welcome assembly was held at the Raritan Expo Center in Edison. Ten thousand devotees had assembled for the grand assembly. A colorful welcome dance was performed by youths. After the garlanding ceremony the Mayor of Edison, George Spodaro, delivered his welcome speech. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Swamishri departed from the BAPS hari mandir in New York for Edison in New Jersey. On the way Swamishri travelled to Long Island and performed the bhumi pujan for a BAPS hari mandir. After briefly blessing the assembly Swamishri departed for darshan of the BAPS hari mandir in Yonkers, Westchester. On arriving there Swamishri performed pujan and arti of all the deities. Though it was getting late to go to Edison, Swamishri patiently enquired about the details of the mandir property. Then Swamishri sanctified each and every part of the mandir. It was 11.15 pm by the time Swamishri left. At 12.15 pm Swamishri arrived in the special assembly for volunteers at the Raritan Expo Center in Edison. More than 1800 volunteers welcomed Swamishri. Then each and every volunteer department welcomed Swamishri with garlands in a unique way. After addressing the volunteers Swamishri arrived at the Edison Mandir at 12.35 pm. A red carpet welcome was accorded to Swamishri. He inaugurated the new mandir bookstall with a remote control switch. Swamishri also complied with a child’s desire to welcome him by applying a chandlo on his head. On arriving before Thakorji, the mandir priest gave an arti to Swamishri. After performing arti, Swamishri saw J.C. Patel, who looks after the mandir accounts. He had requested Swamishri in a letter to perform pujan of the new donation box when he arrived in Edison. Though it was late, nearly 1.00 pm, Swamishri performed pujan. Thereafter Swamishri had lunch and retired for an afternoon nap at 2.00 pm The morning’s hectic scheduled had exhausted Swamishri. On waking up at 5.00 pm Swamishri thought it was morning. When the attendant sadhu told him it was afternoon and that devotees had assembled since 4.30 pm in the mandir hall to have darshan of his walking session, Swamishri came out into the mandir hall and walked for three rounds. Despite the fact that he had to leave for the evening welcome assembly, Swamishri fulfilled the wishes of the devotees. At 6.30 pm Swamishri departed from the mandir to attend the welcome assembly.
Our needs have increased and we have also progressed, but we have gained only material happiness and not peace in one’s atma. (15-5-2004, New York)
When we become humble to God then all our works will be successful. (25-5-2004, New York)
By doing our works in society with humility, politeness, friendliness, servitude and with folded hands people will listen to and have feelings for us. (25-5-2004, New York)
The more humble you become the same amount of humility will be evoked in others; and they will accept what you say. (25-5-2004, New York)
A person becomes successful when he works with humility in society and in his family. (25-5-2004, New York)
If one has faith in God and faith in dharma then success will come from within. (26-5-2004, Edison)
The more the increase in materialism and the more the increase in wealth, the more will there be an increase in vices in man. (28-5-2004, Edison)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
22 May 2004, Edison
Several youths had pilgrimaged a distance of 50 miles by foot from Philadelphia.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was welcomed to New Jersey by devotees on a grand scale at the New Jersey Convention and Exposition Center. At this Swagat, or welcome assembly, Pujya Doctor Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami imparted their wisdom through discourses to all those who had come to receive Swamishri.

After kishores presented their love and devotion to Swamishri in the form of an energetic dance, the mayor of Edison, George Spadoro, welcomed Swamishri and all those who had come from far and wide to Edison with much hospitality. Swamishri concluded the assembly by blessing everyone with the message that peace and spirituality lead to a life of happiness. He then gave everyone the opportunity to have his sameep darshan, where they were able to greet him personally from close by.

In the early morning, as per his daily routine, Pramukh Swami Maharaj went for darshan at the birthplace of Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami. The devotees of Bhadra had been seated here. Swamishri said to them, "This has become the greatest place of pilgrimage. So everyone come for darshan every day. Everyone has served a great deal with body, mind and wealth. May God make all of you happy, and may satsang become the very best. People go on pilgrimage to the Ganga and Yamuna, but you have a pilgrimage sitting at home. So make a special point of coming for darshan every day and remove addictions from the village."

The devotees of the village of Bhadra who serve so devotedly came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Swamishri emphatically told all of them three things: "A big mandir has been built, it is a place of pilgrimage, so come for darshan once every day, and there should be no addiction left in this village at all."

ds.t: "Shall I bow to your feet or your head?"
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj came into his room. Ghanshyamcharan Swami was sitting in the room. As soon as he saw him, Swamishri had his wheelchair brought close and, as if bending down, said, "Shall I bow to your feet or to your head?" Saying this, he placed his hand on his head three times and touched it to his own eyes. What great regard Swamishri has for everyone!!!

When it was time, Pramukh Swami Maharaj went to rest. The curtains were drawn and the lights turned off, and then Swamishri called Kothari Dharmakunvar Swami and himself began talking: "I want a photo taken on the mandir of everyone who has served the mandir, starting with Chandrakantbhai Pujara." Swamishri discussed everything minutely, remembered the devotees for about twenty minutes and gave instructions for them to be called. Accordingly, he remembered Chandrakantbhai Pujara, Kumarbhai Pujara, Dhruv Pujara, and along with them whoever was present from Dajibapu's family, Shambhusinh and Hitendrasinh, and Harishbhai Bhuptani and others, and gave instructions for them to be called, and he also said that Girdharbhai Ghadiya, who had conducted the parayan, should be present. In this way, even while lying in bed, Swamishri was concerned about everyone. Having a photo taken is a small act, but how great it is that Swamishri remembers everyone!!
